description: Shoppers seek responsive support and clear service resolution when encountering order issues to maintain platform trust.
Shoppers evaluate delivered garments against digital visual expectations and tactile quality standards.
Shoppers navigate return rules and replacement steps when received items fail to meet expectations.
Shoppers require timely delivery updates and predictable refund processing when orders are delayed or cancelled.
Shoppers verify merchant trustworthiness and original product authenticity before committing to purchases.
Shoppers assess body fit details, garment dimensions, and size availability before making apparel choices.
Shoppers compare alternative store channels, payment options, and app search interfaces to streamline buying.
Shoppers actively seek promotional discounts, fair fee structures, and transparent pricing to justify their fashion purchases.
Shoppers look for outfit advice, color recommendations, and direct item links to inform style decisions.
